<script>
function DoAddtoCart(url, region, pcode, checksum) {
    location.href = url + '?region=' + region + '&ID_NUM=' + pcode + '&Submit=' + checksum;
}

// Image Carousel & Lightbox
var currentImageIndex = 0;
var imageUrls = [];

function initImageCarousel() {
    // Collect all image URLs from thumbnails
    var thumbnails = document.querySelectorAll('.image-thumbnail');
    imageUrls = Array.from(thumbnails).map(function(thumb) {
        return thumb.getAttribute('data-full-url');
    });
    
    // If no thumbnails (single image), use the large image URL
    if (imageUrls.length === 0) {
        var singleImageUrl = 'images/largeimgB49114594.jpg';
        // Check if the placeholder has been replaced (doesn't contain the dollar sign pattern)
        if (singleImageUrl && singleImageUrl.indexOf('$') === -1 && singleImageUrl.length > 0) {
            imageUrls = [singleImageUrl];
        }
    }
    
    // Set first thumbnail as active
    if (thumbnails.length > 0) {
        thumbnails[0].classList.add('active');
    }
}

function switchMainImage(index) {
    currentImageIndex = index;
    var mainImage = document.querySelector('.product-main-image');
    var thumbnails = document.querySelectorAll('.image-thumbnail');
    
    if (mainImage && imageUrls[index]) {
        mainImage.src = imageUrls[index];
    }
    
    // Update active thumbnail
    thumbnails.forEach(function(thumb, i) {
        if (i === index) {
            thumb.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            thumb.classList.remove('active');
        }
    });
}

function openLightbox(index) {
    currentImageIndex = index || 0;
    var lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightbox');
    var lightboxImage = document.getElementById('lightboxImage');
    var counter = document.getElementById('lightboxCounter');
    var loading = document.getElementById('lightboxLoading');
    
    if (lightbox && lightboxImage) {
        // Show loading spinner
        if (loading) {
            loading.classList.add('active');
        }
        
        // Hide image while loading
        lightboxImage.style.opacity = '0';
        
        // Load new image
        var img = new Image();
        img.onload = function() {
            lightboxImage.src = imageUrls[currentImageIndex];
            lightboxImage.style.opacity = '1';
            if (loading) {
                loading.classList.remove('active');
            }
        };
        img.onerror = function() {
            if (loading) {
                loading.classList.remove('active');
            }
            lightboxImage.style.opacity = '1';
        };
        img.src = imageUrls[currentImageIndex];
        
        lightbox.classList.add('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        
        if (counter) {
            counter.textContent = (currentImageIndex + 1) + ' / ' + imageUrls.length;
        }
        
        // Show/hide nav buttons
        updateLightboxNav();
    }
}

function closeLightbox() {
    var lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightbox');
    if (lightbox) {
        lightbox.classList.remove('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
}

function navigateLightbox(direction) {
    if (direction === 'next' && currentImageIndex < imageUrls.length - 1) {
        currentImageIndex++;
    } else if (direction === 'prev' && currentImageIndex > 0) {
        currentImageIndex--;
    }
    
    var lightboxImage = document.getElementById('lightboxImage');
    var counter = document.getElementById('lightboxCounter');
    var loading = document.getElementById('lightboxLoading');
    
    if (lightboxImage) {
        // Show loading spinner
        if (loading) {
            loading.classList.add('active');
        }
        
        // Hide image while loading
        lightboxImage.style.opacity = '0';
        
        // Load new image
        var img = new Image();
        img.onload = function() {
            lightboxImage.src = imageUrls[currentImageIndex];
            lightboxImage.style.opacity = '1';
            if (loading) {
                loading.classList.remove('active');
            }
        };
        img.onerror = function() {
            if (loading) {
                loading.classList.remove('active');
            }
            lightboxImage.style.opacity = '1';
        };
        img.src = imageUrls[currentImageIndex];
    }
    
    if (counter) {
        counter.textContent = (currentImageIndex + 1) + ' / ' + imageUrls.length;
    }
    
    updateLightboxNav();
}

function updateLightboxNav() {
    var prevBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxPrev');
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById('lightboxNext');
    
    if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.style.display = currentImageIndex === 0 ? 'none' : 'flex';
    }
    
    if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.style.display = currentImageIndex === imageUrls.length - 1 ? 'none' : 'flex';
    }
}

function Init() {
    initImageCarousel();
    
    // Keyboard navigation for lightbox
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        var lightbox = document.getElementById('imageLightbox');
        if (lightbox && lightbox.classList.contains('active')) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                closeLightbox();
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                navigateLightbox('prev');
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                navigateLightbox('next');
            }
        }
    });
}
</script>

        }
